# Zimplifyed

> Zimplifyed is the Export & Import OS for Indian businesses: one secure platform for buyer inquiries, quotes, vendor sourcing, landed cost, shipment documents and compliance, with AI drafting and cross-checking the paperwork. Built for small exporters, merchant traders and importers in India.

Key facts:
- Covers the export journey from inquiry to payment: quoting with Incoterm-aware cost build-ups, vendor RFQs, production tracking, shipment documents cross-checked against one source of order data, shipment milestones, invoicing and export-incentive tracking (RoDTEP, drawback).
- Indian-compliance native: ITC-HS codes, GST/LUT, IEC, RCMC, shipping-bill fields and certificates of origin.
- Free plan available, with paid plans priced in INR.
- AI output is decision support. Duty rates, HS codes and LC reviews should be confirmed with a customs broker (CHA) or bank before filing.

## Free tools
- [HS code finder](https://zimplifyed.ai/tools/hs-finder): describe a product and get an estimated ITC-HS code with duty and RoDTEP hints
- [Landed cost & margin calculator](https://zimplifyed.ai/tools/landed-cost): Incoterm-aware (EXW to DDP) per-unit landed cost, RoDTEP credit and margin
- [LC discrepancy checker](https://zimplifyed.ai/tools/lc-checker): paste a letter of credit and get an AI review of unworkable clauses and date traps
